# Video

Create short video clips from a description of the scene and camera: reels, TikToks, shorts, ads, intros and stories. Generated with Kling, Veo, Seedance, Wan and more.

## What it does
Describe the scene, action and camera movement. Claude picks a model (Kling 3.0 by default; Veo, Seedance, Wan and others on request), tells you the price, and creates the clip. Clips take one to a few minutes.

**How the files are made:** each clip is generated by a video model that MegaScenes runs through its model providers. Nothing is made until you say yes, and the price in credits comes first.

Clips of a few seconds each; 16:9, 9:16 or 1:1 depending on the model.

## Install
In Claude Code:
```
/plugin marketplace add megascenes-app/claude-plugins
/plugin install video@megascenes
```

## Connecting
- Video talks to the MegaScenes server at `https://megascenes.com/api/claude/video/mcp` (Streamable HTTP).
- Connecting opens MegaScenes: sign in, create an account, or continue without one and add your email when you pay (OAuth with PKCE). Then you come straight back to the chat.
- Each clip uses credits from your MegaScenes account and is priced before it runs; new accounts can start with a low-cost trial week.
- Clips take one to a few minutes: Claude checks on progress, and the clip plays in a viewer in the chat where Claude supports interactive apps (a link in Claude Code).

## Tools
| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `list_video_models` | Models for videos with settings and starting prices. Read-only. |
| `estimate_video_cost` | Exact price of one video before it runs. Read-only. |
| `create_video` | Starts one video in your account. Uses credits; needs sign-in. |
| `get_video` | Status and file links. Read-only. |
| `get_account` | Your plan and credit balance. Read-only. |

## Example prompts
- "A 5-second 9:16 shot of a barista pouring latte art, slow motion"
- "Drone shot over a misty mountain lake at sunrise, 16:9"
- "A product reveal of white sneakers spinning on a pedestal"

## Data and privacy
What you give for the clip (the description of the scene, the length and the aspect ratio) goes to MegaScenes, stays in your MegaScenes account with the finished file, and is passed to the model provider that makes it. The plugin has no hooks or local scripts and sends nothing else.
